settings.title: Settings
settings.autosave: Changes are saved instantly and apply right away.
settings.resetDefaults.tip: Restores audio and graphics options to their defaults. Your language and profile stay as they are.
settings.general.language.hint: The whole interface and all game text switch instantly.
settings.general.fullscreen.hint: Hide the browser chrome for a more immersive view.
settings.gfx.quality.hint: Auto tunes effects and resolution to your device. Lower tiers save battery.
settings.gfx.dpr.hint: Limits the pixel density the game renders at. Lower is faster on sharp screens.
settings.gfx.shake.hint: Camera shake on heavy hits and boss attacks. 0% turns it off.
settings.gfx.fps.hint: A small frame-rate readout (F3 toggles it during a run).
settings.gfx.touch.hint: Show the on-screen joystick even without a touchscreen.
settings.keys.intro: These bindings are fixed. Gamepads and touch screens trigger the same actions.
settings.keys.touch: On a touch screen, drag anywhere on the left side to move and tap the buttons on screen.
settings.keys.move.hint: Your hero attacks on its own — just stay alive.
settings.keys.navigate.hint: Move the focus between buttons and cards.
settings.keys.pick.hint: Press the number shown on the card.
settings.keys.pick.hintTouch: Tap a card to pick it.
settings.keys.reroll.hint: Draws a fresh set of cards (limited per run).
settings.keys.banish.hint: Arm it, then pick a card — or hold it while pressing a number.
settings.keys.banish.hintTouch: Arm it, then tap a card.
settings.keys.skip.hint: Take a small heal instead of a card.
settings.keys.pause.hint: Freezes the run and opens the pause menu.
settings.keys.back.hint: Closes the current window or screen.
settings.keys.fps.hint: Shows or hides the frame-rate readout.
settings.profile.title: Profile
settings.profile.name: Profile name
settings.profile.name.hint: Shown in the menu and on the leaderboard.
settings.profile.renameOnline: Saved on this device — your online name could not be updated yet.
settings.profile.onlineLimit: Online names need 3–16 letters, digits or simple symbols; the leaderboard keeps your previous name.
settings.cloud.title: Cloud save
settings.cloud.enable.hint: Creates an anonymous online identity and keeps a backup of your progress.
settings.cloud.offlineNote: Online features are unavailable here. Your progress stays safe in this browser — use Save data to export a backup file.
settings.sync.offline: You're offline — try again once you're connected
settings.sync.disabled: Cloud save is not enabled yet
settings.sync.incompatible: The cloud save comes from a newer version of the game. Update to sync.
settings.sync.conflict: Your cloud and device progress differ — choose which to keep
settings.conflict.title: Two versions of your progress
settings.conflict.text: This device and the cloud both have new progress. Choose the one to keep — the other one is replaced.
settings.conflict.legend: Gold values are the higher ones.
settings.sum.name: Profile
settings.transfer.title: Move to another device
settings.transfer.intro: Create a code here, then enter it on your other device within 15 minutes. Your progress is synced first.
settings.transfer.enter.hint: Type the 8-character code from your other device. This device will then use that profile.
settings.transfer.badFormat: Transfer codes use letters and digits, but never 0, 1, I, L or O.
settings.transfer.needSync: Resolve the sync conflict first, then create a code.
settings.data.export.title: Export save
settings.data.export.text: Download your whole profile — heroes, talents, gear, codex and settings — as a .msav file. Keep it as a backup or carry it to another browser.
settings.data.import.title: Import save
settings.data.import.text: Load a .msav file. It replaces the progress on this device.
settings.data.import.confirmText: “{file}” will replace everything on this device. Here is what it contains:
settings.data.err.format: This isn't a Metin Survivors save file.
settings.data.err.checksum: The file is damaged (checksum mismatch). Try the original export.
settings.data.err.tooNew: This save was made by a newer version of the game.
settings.data.err.noMigration: This save is too old to be converted.
settings.data.err.tooLarge: The file is too large to be a save.
settings.data.err.unknown: The file could not be read.
settings.reset.text: Wipe all progress on this device — heroes, talents, gear, Yeop and shards — and start over. Cloud data stays untouched until the next sync.
settings.reset.confirm1.title: Reset your profile?
settings.reset.confirm1.text: All heroes, talents, gear, Yeop and shards on this device will be erased.
settings.reset.confirm2.title: This cannot be undone
settings.reset.confirm2.text: Type {word} to confirm. Export a backup first if you might want your progress back.
net.fail.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
net.fail.unauthorized: The server did not accept this device's identity. Try enabling cloud save again.
net.fail.rateLimited: Too many attempts — wait a moment and try again.
net.fail.rateLimitedAfter: Too many attempts — try again in {s}s.
net.fail.conflict: The save changed in the meantime. Sync again.
net.fail.invalidCode: That code is invalid or has expired.
net.fail.outdated: This version of the game is out of date. Reload the page to update.
net.fail.server: The server had a problem. Try again shortly.
settings.privacy.title: Privacy
settings.privacy.intro: The game goes online by itself: after your first finished run it creates an anonymous online identity, posts your scores and backs up your progress.
settings.privacy.stores: The server keeps your anonymous player ID and display name (no e-mail, no real name), your cloud save (progress and settings), the results of your runs for the leaderboards, and a hash of your IP address in short-lived counters that limit abuse (never the address itself). Co-op rooms hold your name and hero loadout only while the room is open.
settings.privacy.erase: Deleting erases all of that from the server: cloud save, online identity, runs, leaderboard entries and transfer codes. Progress on this device stays (Save data → Reset profile wipes it). If you finish another run online later, the game creates a new, separate identity.
settings.privacy.unavailable: Online features are unavailable here, so nothing is sent or stored.
settings.privacy.none: This device has no online identity yet, so nothing about you is stored on the server.
settings.privacy.deleted: Cloud data deleted. This device plays offline now.
settings.privacy.failed: Could not delete your cloud data: {reason}
settings.privacy.confirm.title: Delete your cloud data?
settings.privacy.confirm.text: Your online identity, cloud save, runs and leaderboard entries will be erased from the server. This cannot be undone. Progress on this device is not touched.
settings.transfer.create.hint: Makes a one-time code for this profile.
settings.resetDefaults.confirm.title: Reset options?
settings.resetDefaults.confirm.text: Audio, graphics and interface options go back to their defaults. Your language, profile and progress stay as they are.
